description: Remove Services tab from bottom nav, remove hero welcome card and stats from HomeScreen, make all buttons functional (theme/language persistence, edit profile, settings navigation), and UI/UX improvements
steps: In NavGraph.kt: Remove BottomNavItem.Services object completely. Update the 'items' list in FloatingPillBottomNavigation to only have: Home, Campaigns, Shop, Profile (4 tabs). Remove Screen.Services.route from the showBottomBar list in MainScaffold
In NavGraph.kt: Remove the import for ServicesScreen. Keep the composable(Screen.Services.route) route definition so deep links still work but it is no longer in bottom nav

In HomeScreen.kt: Remove the WelcomeCard composable call from the LazyColumn items. Remove the QuickStatsRow composable call. The home screen should start with HomeHeader (Discover title + wallet badge + notifications) then go straight to FeaturedCampaignsSection, then RecentActivitySection, then SearchBar, then FilterChipsRow, then campaigns list
In HomeScreen.kt: Keep WelcomeCard and QuickStatsRow composable definitions in the file (they may be used elsewhere) but remove their items from the LazyColumn

Create app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/local/PreferencesManager.kt - a DataStore-based preferences manager that persists: selectedTheme (System/Light/Dark), selectedLanguage (English/Hindi). Use androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences which is already in dependencies

In MainActivity.kt: Accept theme preference from PreferencesManager and pass the darkTheme parameter to RexoMarketplaceTheme based on the saved preference (System uses isSystemInDarkTheme, Light = false, Dark = true)
In SettingsScreen.kt: Load initial values from PreferencesManager and save when user changes language or theme. The theme change should take effect immediately

In ProfileScreen.kt: Make the Language and Theme settings items navigate to the Settings screen (pass onNavigateToSettings callback). The edit pencil icon on avatar should trigger an edit profile bottom sheet or dialog where user can update name, handle, bio and save to Supabase users table
In ProfileScreen.kt: Add an EditProfileDialog composable that shows TextFields for name, handle, bio. On save, call UserRepository to update the user row in Supabase. Show loading state during save
In UserRepository.kt: Add an updateProfile(userId, name, handle, bio) function that updates the 'users' table row

In ProfileScreen.kt: Make the Notifications settings item navigate to the Settings screen. Make Help & Support navigate to Settings. Ensure all profile page buttons have working onClick handlers that navigate appropriately
In HomeScreen.kt ErrorState composable: Ensure the error message displayed is already sanitized (it comes from ViewModel which now uses ErrorUtils). Do not show raw error text
acceptance_criteria: Bottom navigation has exactly 4 tabs: Home, Campaigns, Shop, Profile
HomeScreen does not show WelcomeCard or QuickStatsRow
HomeScreen starts with Discover header then featured campaigns then search/filter
Theme preference persists across app restarts via DataStore
Language preference persists across app restarts via DataStore
Edit Profile dialog appears when tapping edit icon on profile avatar
Edit Profile saves changes to Supabase users table
All buttons on Profile page have functional onClick handlers
Settings Language/Theme dialogs save to DataStore and apply immediately
verification: Check NavGraph.kt bottom nav items list has exactly 4 items (no Services)
Check HomeScreen.kt LazyColumn does not include WelcomeCard or QuickStatsRow items
Check PreferencesManager.kt exists with theme and language DataStore preferences
findings: All changes implemented successfully. Bottom nav reduced to 4 tabs (Services removed from BottomNavItem sealed class and items list but route kept for deep links). WelcomeCard and QuickStatsRow removed from LazyColumn items but function definitions kept in file. PreferencesManager uses preferencesDataStore extension. RexoApplication.preferencesManager initialized in companion object. MainActivity uses collectAsState(initial) on the Flow. SettingsScreen uses scope.launch with preferencesManager.setThemeMode/setLanguage. ProfileScreen EditProfileDialog uses UserRepository.updateProfile with mutableMapOf for partial updates. All profile settings items wired to onNavigateToSettings callback.
